departments.name: Cardiology & Vascular Medicine
departments.prep_instructions: Fasting 8 hours prior if lipid or angiography testing is ordered. Bring recent ECG records.

departments.name: Orthopedic Surgery & Sports Medicine
departments.prep_instructions: Wear loose, comfortable clothing allowing easy joint examination. Bring prior X-ray/MRI CDs.

departments.name: Neurology & Brain Sciences
departments.prep_instructions: Wash hair the night before and avoid hair styling products if EEG is planned. Bring headache/seizure journal.

departments.name: General Internal Medicine
departments.prep_instructions: Bring all current prescription bottles or detailed medication list. Bring immunization history.

departments.name: Emergency & Urgent Triage Center
departments.prep_instructions: Immediate in-person arrival. Do not drive yourself if experiencing chest pain, stroke symptoms, or severe shortness of breath. Call 911 immediately if emergency.
